_comment: dacl10k (19 sigmoid channels) -> Drishyam (6-way) merge. Channel order is dacl10k-toolkit Dacl10kDataset.TARGET_LIST; the model's 19 output channels follow it. Edit 'map' and re-run export_onnx.py: the merge lives in the exported graph, so no retraining is needed.
source: https://github.com/phiyodr/dacl10k-toolkit (dacl10k/dacl10kdataset.py TARGET_LIST; README 'Labels/Classes'); paper Flotzinger et al., WACV 2024, arXiv:2309.00460, appendix Tables 7-9
